submitted.rationale: XRD at indices 4, 10, 14 and 20 showed the same rutile-type pattern across the whole line, with an extra peak on the Sb-rich side at 1.91 Å⁻¹. Peak intensity dropped as Sb increased. EQE also rose steadily as Fe increased: 0.015% at Fe0.48 (idx 14), 0.032% at Fe0.74 (idx 5) and 0.063% at Fe0.82 (idx 1). Of the three measured, index 1 is the best.
